title: Battle of Toulon (1744)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Toulon (1744)", at revision 1378693778, opens: "The Battle of Toulon took place on 21 and 22 February 1744 NS near the French Mediterranean port of Toulon. Although France was not yet at war with Britain, ships from their Levant Fleet supported an attempt by a Spanish force trapped in Toulon to break through the British Mediterranean Fleet." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q677929, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1744 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
